Dress up in Bavarian costumes, prepare your biggest mug and plunge headlong into this authentic festival.🍻🥨

notes.title: Labor Day
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24294817/405897dd490e86631dda673d1c250936762053f7.png[/img]

What? This Puppeteer wants us to work on Labor Day? Unthinkable! Down with tyranny! We're going on strike!
The residents of the mansion are divided into two camps: some want to hold a peaceful demonstration, others want to cause a pogrom! It's up to you to decide whose side you'll take! ⚒

What will you need to make the protest a success?
Find Torn Leaflets or Anarchy Stickers in the rooms, but remember, once you start the test in the room and choose one, you won't be able to choose the other until the end of the test!

🍖When everything is ready, declare your rights for everyone to hear and go to rest. The best solution would be to have a barbecue, because now you have a brand new grill, a gift from the Puppeteer himself. He was ready to do anything, just so you could stop this chaos.🍹

Long live Labor Day!

notes.title: The Big Construction!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24294817/c6a53a2227cf35f896acf2e927382cc5e8d08070.png[/img]

☀️ It's August, and the heat is not going to recede even a degree. Even in the shade there is no shelter from the scorching heat. Something must be done about this! The Big Construction site is announced in the mansion.🛠

The Thermometer has appeared in your room. He is your main salvation from the heat. You can activate The Thermometer using Building Tokens.
You can get tokens by combining Construction Hammers and Hacksaws.

Pass tests in the rooms of the mansion and get treasured items. Every 5 tokens you use on The Thermometer will give you a 1% bonus to experience gained. Collect enough tokens and The Thermometer will increase your maximum health and stay with you until the end of the month!

This time there are not 2 rewards for progress, but 4 at once: 25, 50, 75 and 100 percent of progress will bring you special prizes.🎁

The Big Construction has begun!

notes.title: Unified progress on all platforms!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24294817/cd4952439da5a1c1117327fa8ae87142ead56502.png[/img]

🔊Great news for players on all platforms!

Now you can have common progress for all platforms (both mobile and PC), and move from one to another without restrictions, in two simple steps:

1️⃣To upload your progress to another platform, simply click the "Copy game progress" button in the settings and get a unique code.

2️⃣After that, on the platform where you want to continue the game, select "Add progress" in the settings and enter the received code in the window.

Please note that the code is valid for 5 minutes, if you did not have time to enter it during this time, you need to get a new one.

After that, when you log in to your account, you will see a choice of several progress options. Choose the one you need now and enter the game. Progress options can be switched at any time upon login.

Play "The Panic Room" where it is convenient for you and in the way it is convenient for you!

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Updated Halloween Event
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24294817/7840d10af29c9fb2db7162de14c188dacea1fb72.png[/img]

🎃Have you already prepared your costume? A cute little witch? Or a bloodthirsty vampire? Or maybe a thousand-year-old mummy? Whoever you dress up as - today is your holiday. Halloween is already in the mansion!🎃

You'll have to try hard to get rewards! First, go to the rooms of the house. You will find special hammers in them. In addition, pumpkins are hiding in the rooms. Don't miss a single one!

Break the pumpkins on the house plan and collect the "Eyes". Boo-ga-ga!👻

What Halloween is complete without carols? Go into your friends' rooms and collect sweets! The more - the better!🍭

There are plenty of themed rewards and other... Halloween delights! Trick or treat?

notes.title: Columbus Day
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24294817/90582a570d64b46828dde394bede5ccd634aefc3.png[/img]

All aboard! Our ship is setting off on a trip around the world in honor of Columbus Day!🚢
Circumnavigating the world is not an easy adventure and you can’t do it without a map. Collect the fragments into a full-fledged map and create a travel route using the special Captain’s Globe decor.✨
What's a trip without a ship? Collect and combine Bottles with a map and get the ship of Columbus himself - Santa Maria (in miniature, of course).🚢
Finally, by acquiring a map and preparing your ship, you can discover the real New World!
Is everyone ready to set sail? Then we're waiting for you at the Puppeteer's Mansion!

notes.title: Harvest Festival
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24294817/8503dec1800410f2fbe4affc099a7d22861f38d5.png[/img]

🍁Summer is over, which means it’s time for the harvest! Don't be afraid, your head will remain in place, although the scale of the fun may blow the roof off! Can't wait anymore? Now we’ll tell you everything!🍁
Get ready to weave with straw! Spikelets are hidden in the rooms of the mansion. Collect enough of them and get the “Last Sheaf” decor.🌾
To decorate the Lugnasad doll you will need brooches. You can find them in nighttime modes of rooms. As soon as there are enough brooches, you can use them to make the “Natural Irresistibility” decor.🌹
Can you smell the ripe pears? Go through daytime room modes and collect pears to collect the “Harvest Day” decor.
🍂Happy Lughnasad!🍂

notes.title: Labor Day
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24294817/032aa572b242d06b2232e0b77743e57380be83c1.png[/img]

What? This Puppeteer wants us to work on Labor Day? Unthinkable! Down with arbitrariness! We are going on strike!

The inhabitants of the mansion are divided into two camps: some want to arrange a peaceful demonstration, others - a pogrom! It's up to you to decide which side you take!
What do you need to make the protest successful?

To begin with, the “voice” of the strike is the workers. For the passage of any rooms you will receive figures of workers. Gathering enough workers will give you the Strike you've been waiting for.

The next step is campaigning. Find Torn Leaflets or Anarchy Stickers in the rooms, but remember, once you start the test in the room and choose one, you will not be able to choose another until the end of the test!

And finally, you have to prove that you have worked hard all year and are entitled to a well-deserved rest! The proof will be Labor badges, collect them in the daytime modes of the rooms.

🍖 When everything is ready, declare your rights publicly and go to rest. The best solution would be to have a barbecue, because now you have a brand new grill, donated personally by the Puppeteer. He was ready for anything, if only you would stop this chaos.🍹

Long live Labor Day!

notes.title: The Big Construction!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24294817/c6a53a2227cf35f896acf2e927382cc5e8d08070.png[/img]

 It's August, and the heat is not going to recede even a degree. Even in the shade there is no shelter from the scorching heat. Something must be done about this! The Big Construction site is announced in the mansion.🛠

The Thermometer has appeared in your room. He is your main salvation from the heat. You can activate The Thermometer using Building Tokens.
You can get tokens by combining Construction Hammers and Hacksaws.

Pass tests in the rooms of the mansion and get treasured items. Every 5 tokens you use on The Thermometer will give you a 1% bonus to experience gained. Collect enough tokens and The Thermometer will increase your maximum health and stay with you until the end of the month!

This time there are not 2 rewards for progress, but 4 at once: 25, 50, 75 and 100 percent of progress will bring you special prizes.🎁

The Big Construction has begun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24294817/1f6736495ad5c185fc63b880e244833866e239b7.png[/img]

notes.title: Event "New Year's Eve"
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24294817/59e195bb89b86c04988d80b98e2c40b7f6a960a4.png[/img]

❄️The most magical and wonderful holiday is coming. The Puppeteer invites all puppets to celebrate this New Year in his mansion!❄️

There's already a Christmas tree stand set up in your room! Go through the challenges in the mansion and look for Spruce Branches in the rooms. You'll need them to assemble the entire Christmas tree!🎄
Once the main symbol of the holiday is in place, it needs to be decorated with Christmas decorations. To do this, complete rooms in daytime modes.

New Year's Eve should be celebrated with family and friends! Give your friends some holiday cards! For putting them together, you'll get a whole mountain of holiday goodies that will restore your health.❤️

And what's a New Year's Eve without presents? Get into the spirit of the New Year, collect festive items (branches and toys) and special prizes will be yours!🎁

Let's celebrate together! At The Puppeteer's Mansion!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24294817/bddb793b72f745b4db0bf0fbf6fbda882aafdc7d.png[/img]

The Puppeteer always takes care of his puppets, so he cut the prices of all health items  by 30%.

notes.title: Event Zodiac: Capricorn
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24294817/f6cea778e964c126ac82eed091cc20e89fc3be51.png[/img]

The observatory door is open! After spending the whole night at the telescope, and having almost given up hope, you notice how Capricorn begins to shine.🔮

You know what to do. Pass the test at the observatory and a constellation will be revealed to you on the house plan. Go through the marked rooms in night modes in order and collect stars. Complete the stars with special collections and the power of the earth sign will be yours.⚡

Enhance the power of your decor with elemental symbols. Receive boxes from collections, and the boxes contain elemental particles, which are combined into treasured signs.

The wheel of constellations inexorably continues its cycle. Answer the call of the stars and they will reward you for your help! ✨

notes.title: Event "Thanksgiving Day"
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24294817/873b7ad6f6f5541ac7076552ddcc366331b7cad3.png[/img]

Mmmm... what a wonderful aroma... It's Jenny in the Kitchen who has already roasted the turkey, and soon all the inhabitants of the mansion will gather around the table, leaving the usual activities behind. It's a good time to start the Thanksgiving feast - a tribute to those distant events when the first settlers came to the land of the new continent and broke bread with its natives.🍗

In the rooms of the mansion you will find the Pilgrims, and in day modes you will find Arrows. You will need these items to set the Totem of Spirits on the house plan. Present the Spirit Essences to the ancestors to receive their blessings and valuable items.💎
The Puppeteer invites everyone to celebrate this momentous occasion at his mansion.

notes.title: Zodiac Event: Saggitarius
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24294817/171ddf77c9cb390d664d5a72f3edb220e3644c09.png[/img]

✨Another cloudless night has arrived and Sagittarius favors the inhabitants of the mansion. To get the full power of the fire sign, collect the lenses in day fountain and head to the Observatory. Complete the challenge successfully and the constellation will appear on the house plan - it will guide you forward. 

Pass through the marked rooms in Night and Stash mode and collect the stars. Combine the stars and the eternal zodiacal decor becomes yours. It will increase your maximum health reserve. Want more? Then collect special collections. Each collection will add to the progress bar and turn into a box of elements, which contains elemental particles. 

Once you have enough particles, they can be combined into tokens, which are used to improve your decor. So what are you waiting for? Hurry up and make an offering to Sagittarius at The Puppeteer's Mansion.✨

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24294817/b94b0c56087de66b0b33422fe3c426cf2e5ec5bd.jpg[/img]

🍁Summer is over, which means it’s time for the harvest! Don't be afraid, your head will remain in place, although the scale of the fun may blow the roof off! Can't wait anymore? Now we’ll tell you everything!🍁

Get ready to weave with straw! Spikelets are hidden in the rooms of the mansion. Collect enough of them and get the “Last Sheaf” decor.🌾

To decorate the Lugnasad doll you will need brooches. You can find them in nighttime modes of rooms. As soon as there are enough brooches, you can use them to make the “Natural Irresistibility” decor.🌹
Can you smell the ripe pears? Go through daytime room modes and collect pears to collect the “Harvest Day” decor.

5 puzzles have been prepared for the harvest festival, which means you can collect 5 wonderful autumn pieces of art at once. Don't miss this opportunity!🖼

🍂Happy Lughnasad!🍂

notes.title: Labor Day event
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24294817/a4853310e376eaa90cedccec348929d3b45b51a6.png[/img]

What? This Puppeteer wants us to work on Labor Day? Unthinkable! Down with arbitrariness! We are going on strike!
The inhabitants of the mansion are divided into two camps: some want to arrange a peaceful demonstration, others - a pogrom! It's up to you to decide which side you take!


What do you need to make the protest successful?
To begin with, the “voice” of the strike is the workers. For the passage of any rooms you will receive figures of workers. Gathering enough workers will give you the Strike you've been waiting for.
The next step is campaigning. Find Torn Leaflets or Anarchy Stickers in the rooms, but remember, once you start the test in the room and choose one, you will not be able to choose another until the end of the test!


And finally, you have to prove that you have worked hard all year and are entitled to a well-deserved rest! The proof will be Labor badges, collect them in the daytime modes of the rooms.


🍖 When everything is ready, declare your rights publicly and go to rest. The best solution would be to have a barbecue, because now you have a brand new grill, donated personally by the Puppeteer. He was ready for anything, if only you would stop this chaos.🍹


Long live Labor Day!

notes.title: Bank bonus
notes.content:
Tell me, haven't you been haunted lately by the urge to just catch or capture someone? Hey... put that rope away... Don't make jokes, we're not talking about the people here!
I'm talking about rats, crows and other mongooses. It's obvious to the deaf that they don't come and go for nothing... Something's on their mind - they're just wandering around, those sly beasts. And you know, only a complete fool would just sneak around! I think they want us to pay attention to them on purpose. So they want to share all sorts of useful things... Maybe they like it more than anything else in the world to be caught and snatched in unexpected ways? And every net or trap is a real gift to them? What do you say?
What? Where to get all sorts of ratchets and strong nets and even ghost traps? Well, I'll tell you - in a jar. As many as you want. There's no limit to what you can get as a gift. For depositing your account.
And see you on the hunt!

notes.title: Key to start!
notes.content:
What was that rumbling noise just now? You look out the window and realize that something strange has fallen into the yard. It looks like debris from a spaceship. It's up to you to figure out what happened. The Key to start, dear puppets!🔑
Explore the mansion room to collect parts from the spaceship. Build your spaceship and send it into space! To launch the rocket, you need fuel, which you can get for collecting unique space collections. Load the rocket with the essentials and it will return with useful rewards. It's up to you to decide what to put in the cargo bay!💎
Complete the tasks and unravel the reasons behind what happened. Maybe you'll meet new friends 🐶
Collect the action puzzles and you'll keep them as a memento of this momentous event!
Everyone ready? Let's go then 🚀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24294817/3f7246cba682db2f5089f0df3945868eeed177e9.png[/img]

notes.title: Zodiac: Capricorn
notes.content:
The observatory door is open! You've been waiting for the light of Serpentine to come on over the mansion. After spending the whole night at the telescope, and almost giving up hope, you notice Capricorn starting to shine.🔮
He brings the message that the great healer must gain strength, and now is Capricorn's time to help the inhabitants of the cursed house.⭐
You know what to do. Pass the test in the observatory and the constellation on the plan of the house will be revealed to you. Go through the marked rooms in Night and Mystery modes in order and collect the stars. Combine the stars and the power of the earth sign will be yours.⚡
Strengthen the power of the decor with the signs of the elements. Build collections, get tokens, turn tokens into boxes, and the boxes contain elemental particles that combine into coveted signs.
The constellation wheel continues its cycle inexorably. Answer the call of the stars and they will reward you for your help!🎁

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24294817/dd5cff2b9841b667ebcbabb0cae67fd152342ce9.jpg[/img]

notes.content:
Not only people live in the Puppet Master's house. Or not live, but exist. Sometimes. Well, you know... Some of them you have already had to deal with. But there are others. They're around, picking the right moment to attack.
You'll need weapons to emerge victorious from the battle with them.💣
Now's the time to stock up your arsenal-weapons prices will be discounted by 30% all week!🛡
But maybe you're a brave hero and the devil himself is running away from you. I understand that might be a problem over time. But then I bet you'll love the 30% discount on items for summoning bosses.⚔
Stock up on everything you need to fight the bosses and victory will always be on your side!
And if you've been injured in battle - no problem. As a gift for topping up your account you'll get food or medicine sets to patch up your wounds. There's no limit to the number of gifts you can get!🍎

notes.title: Legend catchers!
notes.content:
Ready for another surprise? Today the Puppeteer is granting wishes! True, not all, but only mysterious, mythical and even mystical! In short, the "Legend Catchers" action is already in play! 🔮

So, welcome to the world of exciting and magical stories about King Arthur, the wizard Merlin and the Knights of the Round Table. Take part in the quest (you remember - all those legendary guys did nothing but search for something) and get a valuable artifact. But you'll have to sweat it out to do it!

Find the chest in your room. Let me tell you a secret: we've got the darkness of the Middle Ages all over the place. No new technology, just good old-fashioned witchcraft. Of course, the chest isn't just any chest, it has a "surprise" in it. It hides a spell. Activate the spells - their special effect will allow you to find special Tokens. Look for tokens in the rooms of the mansion - you can use them to unlock the code lock.
Collect Event Collections to find the key card with the code to the chest.
And finally open it! 🔓

🎁You'll find prizes inside. Keep opening the chest, there will be more and more valuable rewards in it, including special decor and a certificate for VIP status! 💎

The puppeteer is waiting for you!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24294817/56b64b07f45315402abe5cd77f70531f7a0ea727.jpg[/img]

Catch nocturnal creatures on the house plan!
If you catch a Mottled or Barn Owl, you can get Owl Feathers. Collect feathers, and get rewards! 🎁
A Fuzzy Owl will give Painted Feathers. If you collect enough of these feathers, the Owl decor will appear in your room.
Don't forget about the promotional collections. You can get lots of prizes for combining them, including puzzle charms!
Don't miss out on an exciting event!

notes.title: 🔱The "Wonders of the world" event has started! 🔱
notes.content:
🔱 Hooray! The monolith is back on the house plan, which means we can go on a new expedition. Meet the Wonders of the World: Halicarnassus Mausoleum.🔱
Catch rats and crows and collect medallions for catching them. Place the collected medallions in the monolith and get special collection items. Then go to the courtyard for the tools to combine them. Collected collections will turn into Scraps of Paper. From them you can make a Map of Wonders.📜
The next step is the trials. There are cave paintings hidden in the rooms of the mansion. Combine the drawings to get the Sculpture.
Now for the fun part. Combine the Wonder Map and the Sculpture and you become the owner of the real wonder of the world, the Gallican Mausoleum. 🏛
But that's not all. keep merging and the Marionette and Raccoon pet decor will also end up in your room.
Travel with us, in the Puppet Mansion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24294817/369229ee2b01e9f404adfab87046601da3444d0f.png[/img]

A dangerous game has begun in the mansion. You are faced with a difficult task. There are ducklings in the rooms of the house. But they are not as easy as they look. Each one is a deadly trap.🔪
Get a mousetrap for each activated duck. Combine mousetraps and win valuable prizes. 🎁
Don't forget the Trap Lords decor. It will reduce the cost of entering rooms. Upgrade the décor to increase the bonus.
Be careful in the Puppeteer Mansion.

Puppetmaster has some New Year's surprises in store for you! Do not miss updates. They are sure you will love them!🎁
And here's the first surprise! The "Jelly bean party" has started at the mansion!🍮
Jenny made lots of sweet Jelly Bears and hid them in the rooms.Go through the challenges, get the Jelly Bears and win lots of great prizes! New rewards every day!🐻
Your main goal will be a unique puzzle! Find all the pieces of the puzzle, assemble the colorful art and Jenny will hand you a very delicious Cake that will completely restore your health!
What are you waiting for? The Jelly bean party is starting!

notes.title: Thanksgiving Day
notes.content:
Mmmm... what a wonderful aroma... It's Jenny in the Kitchen who has already roasted the turkey, and soon all the inhabitants of the mansion will gather around the table, leaving the usual activities behind. It's a good time to start the Thanksgiving feast - a tribute to those distant events when the first settlers came to the land of the new continent and broke bread with its natives.🍗
In the rooms of the mansion you will find the Pilgrims, and by activating the areas in the courtyard you will find the Arrows. You will need these items to set the Totem of Spirits on the house plan. Present the Spirit Essences to the ancestors to receive their blessings and valuable items.💎
Look for and open the Holiday Gifts. They contain the amulets of holiday puzzles for which you can get special rewards for collecting.💰
The puppeteer invites everyone to celebrate this momentous occasion at his mansion.

notes.title: Zodiac: Sagittarius
notes.content:
✨The constellation of Sagittarius is visible in the sky. This means that it is time for the Zodiac.✨
To gain the full power of the fiery sign, head to the Observatory. Complete the challenge successfully and the constellation will appear on the house plan - it will guide you forward. Pass through the marked rooms in Night and Stash mode and collect the stars. Combine the stars and the eternal zodiacal decor becomes yours. It will increase your maximum health reserve.❤️
Want more? Then collect special collections. Each collection will turn into Sagittarius tokens - and you can exchange them for elemental boxes that contain elemental particles. Once you have enough particles, they can be combined into tokens, which are used to improve your decor.🌌
So what are you waiting for? Hurry up and make an offering to Sagittarius at the Puppet Master's Mansion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24294817/97bd3ae449535ad543d6223ed16b5db9799affc6.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Quick sale
notes.content:
Tell me, haven't you been haunted lately by the urge to just catch or capture someone? Hey... put that rope away... Don't make jokes, we're not talking about the people here!
I'm talking about rats, crows and other mongooses. It's obvious to the deaf that they don't come and go for nothing... Something's on their mind - they're just wandering around, those sly beasts. And you know, only a complete fool would just sneak around! I think they want us to pay attention to them on purpose. So they want to share all sorts of useful things... Maybe they like it more than anything else in the world to be caught and snatched in unexpected ways? And every net or trap is a real gift to them? What do you say?
What? Where to get all sorts of ratchets and strong nets and even ghost traps? Well, I'll tell you - in a jar. As many as you want. There's no limit to what you can get as a gift. For depositing your account.
Also, the Puppeteer has reduced the prices of amulets. 30% off! Look for the items you need in the store.
And see you on the hunt!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24294817/370d1994afca2708ce3cef7394757fd970471d41.jpg[/img]

Some will increase the chance of finding a rare item or piece of the puzzle. Others will bring extra experience or copper tokens. Each position in the jar has its own set. Choose the one you like best!🖼

notes.title: 💥The “Cryptexes” event has started!💥
notes.content:
What is that strange box in your room? You have to open it by all means!
Collect a special promotional collection to get the Cryptexes. Use them to break the cipher and find out what's hidden in the box.
How? Another box? Keep collecting, combine the cryptexes and open new boxes. The last one will turn into a useful decoration.
Combining crypttexes will earn you freedom points: 250, 500, 1000, and even 2500 for the main Megacrypttex. Merge cryptexes as many times as you like. There are no limits!
🗝Solve the tricky puzzle at the Puppeteer's mansion!🗝

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24294817/67e71d25f0832f5ee46dd7af938b650de33e97e9.jpg[/img]

notes.title: The "Big Hunt" event has started!
notes.content:
🐭Rats and crows are on guard. These weasels have already guessed that the Big Hunt has begun. Catch them!🐦
The springs are your target! You can find them at the feathered and tailed (yes, yes, rats and crows). The house plan now has a special Jet Fauna representative that you can get even more springs for catching! To do this, you'll need special equipment: retarders and electric traps.🔧
Springs are needed to assemble a special décor - the Automaton Crow! It will reduce the cost of entering the rooms of the mansion, increase the chance to find frequent and very frequent items from rats and crows, and bring a bonus to the earned freedom points.
What are you waiting for? Rats and crows won't catch themselves!

notes.title: 🔱The "Wonders of the world" event has started! 🔱
notes.content:
🔱We are going on a new journey. This time we're going to China. Meet the world's wonders. Wonders of the World: The Forbidden City.🔱
The monolith is already active. Catch rats and crows and get medallions. Use them to activate the monolith and get rewards and exclusive collectibles.
Once you have enough collection artifacts, activate the areas in the courtyard. In them you will find the tools to combine these very collections. Each collection will bring you scraps of paper. You will need them later.📜
Pass trials in the rooms of the mansion and find the Cave paintings in them. Once you have collected enough scraps and drawings, combine them and the coveted decor in the form of the real Forbidden City will be yours.🖼
Don't stop there. Keep collecting scraps and drawings and you can get your hands on the puppet décor and the charming pet Raccoon.
Our exciting adventure in China begins! Onward to the unknown!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24294817/369229ee2b01e9f404adfab87046601da3444d0f.png[/img]

Choose whichever one you like best!💊

notes.title: Halloween event
notes.content:
🎃Have you got your costume ready? The cute little witch? Or a bloodthirsty vampire? Or a thousand-year-old mummy? Whoever you're dressed up as - today is your holiday. Halloween is in the mansion!🎃
You'll have to do your best to get your reward! First, go to the rooms of the house. You'll find pumpkins in all of them. Don't miss a single one!
What's Halloween without carols? Go into your friends' rooms and collect candy! The more the better!🍭
Smash pumpkins on the house plan and collect "Eyes". Boo-ha-ha!
There's something interesting hidden in the promotional collections, too! Each one will turn into a potion when collected. Use this potion to see and collect Vedic Signs as you pass the challenge!👻
There are plenty of themed rewards and other... Halloween delights! Trick or treat?

notes.content:

Someone has already rolled into your room biergarten. To decorate it, you'll need bierdecks, kegs, and pretzels.
For the mug stands, go to the rooms of the mansion. That's where they're hidden, so keep your eyes peeled for them.
The holiday collections turn into barrels, and you'll find pretzels from the rats and crows.🥨
Collect enough of each item and the Oktoberfest decor is yours.
Dress up in Bavarian costumes, prepare your biggest mug, and dive headfirst into this distinctive festival.🍻

notes.title: Columbus Day
notes.content:
All aboard! Our ship is going around the world in honor of Columbus Day!🚢
Around the world is not an easy adventure, so invite your friends and play together. It's not only fun, it's also rewarding. Give and receive map fragments as gifts from your mates. Assemble a full map from the fragments and create a travel itinerary with the special Captain's Globe décor.✨
Get equipped for your trek. Challenge yourself in the rooms of the mansion, and collect holiday collectibles. Combine them with the tools that the rats and crows have already dragged away to their dens and nests. For each collection you collect you'll get special rewards and Magnetized Needles - you need them to make a compass and not to lose your way. When you have enough needles they can be combined to get food supplies for your expedition.🧭
Our nimble "friends" have stashed more than just tools for collections. If you catch a rat or a crow you'll find Bottles of cards. Combine the required number of bottles and your reward will be a décor - a model of Columbus' flagship ship, the Santa Maria.
You don't just go on a voyage around the world. Every sailor dreams of one day finding a treasure. Become a real sailor, stand at the helm of the entire mission and assemble a puzzle Captain of the Ship. Then activate the unique amulet Jolly Roger and start searching for treasure in the backyard. Activate the areas and maybe luck will smile on you. The treasure chest holds 10,000 copper tokens and random decor for your room.💰
Is everyone ready to set sail? Then we're waiting for you, at the Puppeteer's Mansion!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24294817/0efb01d580ed51a71c0f5b568d6f66b41a639333.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Harvest party
notes.content:

Get ready to weave in some straw! There are spikelets hidden in the rooms of the mansion. Collect enough of them and get the "Last Sheaf" decor.🌾
You'll need brooches to decorate the Lugnasad doll. You will get them as a reward for collecting holiday collections. You'll find these collections in the Collector's Boxes and the tools for combinations in the rats and crows. Once you have enough brooches, you can use them to make a Natural Irresistible decoration.🌹
Can you smell ripe pears? Here, too, our little pranksters smell it and stash all the fruit at their place. Catch the rats and crows and collect the pears to create a "Harvest Day" decor.
There are 5 puzzles prepared for Harvest Day, which means you'll be able to put together 5 wonderful fall arts at once. Do not miss this opportunity!🖼

notes.title: Labor day
notes.content:
What? This Puppet Master wants us to work on Labor Day? Unthinkable! Down with arbitrariness! Let's go on strike!
The residents of the mansion are divided into two camps: some want to stage a peaceful demonstration, others want to stage a pogrom! It's up to you to decide which side you'll take!
What do you need to make this protest a success?
For starters, the "voice" of the strike is the workers. Look for the keys to the Celebration Room. This is where the Worker figurines are hidden. If you collect enough Workers, you will get the Strike you are waiting for.
The next step is agitation. Get collection boxes and Labor Day Bags with tools to combine them, which will be the reward for successfully completing the trials in the same Celebration Room. Some collections will turn into Torn Flyers, others into Stickers of Anarchy. Concentrate on those collections which way you have chosen.🔧
Finally, you should prove that you've worked hard all year and are entitled to a well-deserved vacation! The proof is in the form of work badges. Rats and crows will find them.🐭
🍖When you're done, declare your rights at the top of your voice and go on vacation. The best solution is to have a barbecue, because now you have a brand new grill presented personally by the Puppeteer. He'd do anything to get you to stop this chaos.🍹
Happy Labor Day!

All aboard! We're off on an exciting journey through India!
Our tour will consist of 3 stages: activating the Monolith, collecting collections, and searching for the Cave Paintings.
We'll start with the Monolith. Catch the rats and crows on the house plan and collect the Medallions. Place the Medallions in the Monolith and obtain special collection items as well as useful rewards.
The second item on the program is the event collections. Head to the backyard. The collection joining items are hidden in areas. Once you put the collection together it will turn into Scraps of Paper (we will still need them).📜
Finally, you will be tested in the rooms of the mansion. There are cave paintings hidden in them. Look carefully!🖼
Once all the preparations are made, the grand finale is here! Combine the Map of Wonders, assembled from Scraps of Paper and the Sculpture, assembled from the Cave paintings and you'll get a real miniature copy of the Taj Mahal. It will stay with you forever!
Continue on your journey (yes, yes, we were a little hasty about the finale) and then you can get your hands on even more valuable treasures: the Marionette decor and the furry pet Raccoon!
Don't just stand there! Come with us on our quest to find the Wonders of the World!✨

Complete the challenge in the Observatory, finish the room chain marked by the constellation and get rewards such as the Gemini puzzle amulet, food, copper, fern garlands, golden horseshoes, money trees.

Collections, puzzles, quests - all of this awaits you in Puppeteer's mansion! Hurry up and tame the element of wind and grand prizes will be yours!♊

notes.title: Bank holidays
notes.content:
🔥"Bank holidays" event is already in the game!🔥
The warmest season is coming! It's time to say goodbye to the spring and meet the summer. With that in mind, the Puppeteer has prepared lots of prizes.
Take a break and embrace the atmosphere of warmth and comfort. Complete unique collections - each of them will bring you healing items and other useful items.
You can find the symbols of the holiday - the dandelions - in mansion's rooms. Weave the flower bracelet and get a triple laser pointer. A flower pin will bring you an amulet to find pieces of special event puzzles. And a flower hoop will reward your efforts with a net and trap bundle.
Little critters in the mansion are feeling the summer's approach as well. Catch rats and crows - you can find some interesting items from them. This time they will bring you flutes! Exchange them for magical elixirs and talismans which will help you in your journey.
And how could we forget about the main asset of the upcoming season? You can place your own little Sun in your room!☀️
🎉Don't stand apart and join everybody!🎉

notes.title: Ortho, the Restless Automaton
notes.content:

notes.title: New eventual collections!
notes.content:
At the end of the Christmas holidays Krampus have also decided to participate in the celebration!
Now in the rooms of the house you can find a collection “Presents for all”. You will find activators in friends' decorations. Combine it to get the activators for the collection “Socks for gifts”, which items can be found in the backyard, and for which generous Santa will give you one of his chests.

 If you want to open it you have to negotiate with Krampus that holds the key. To do this, look for items of the collection “Greetings from Krampus” in friends' decorations, combine it and the key is yours. The Krampus ember and the Quintessence of magic can be found in rats and crows.

 Open the Santa's chest and you will be able to get very impressive rewards!

Have a nice game!


Под конец новогодних торжеств Крампус тоже решил поучаствовать в празднике! 
Теперь в комнатах дома вы сможете найти коллекцию “Подарки для всех”. Активаторы вы найдете в декоре друзей. Объединяйте ее, чтобы набрать активаторов для коллекции “Носки в подарок”, за которую щедрый Санта отдаст вам один из своих сундуков. 

Если хотите открыть его вам придется договориться с Крампусом, хранящим ключ. Для этого ищите коллекцию “Поздравление от крампуса” в декоре друзей, объединяйте и ключ ваш. Угольки Крампуса и квинтэссенцию волшебства вы найдете у крыс ворон. 

Открывайте сундучок Санты и вы сможете получить впечатляющие награды!

Приятной игры!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24294817/824986bbcd3356f1afcb8a105359e5e42913f41f.jpg[/img]

notes.content:
It's high time to tune to the "Liberty radio" and get ready to make double the efforts on the path to freedom! 
Astrology lessons were not in vain — the inhabitants of the mansion have found a satellite in the sky. 

You have the chance to contact the outside world! 
Do not miss this unique opportunity!


Внимание, Игроки! 

Настало время настроиться на волну «Радио свободы» ! 
Приготовьтесь приложить двойные усилия на пути к достижению свободы! 
Занятия астрологией не прошли даром — жители особняка обнаружили спутник на небе. 

У вас есть шанс связаться с внешним миром. 
Не упустите такую уникальную возможность!

notes.title: Starfire Ophiuchus
notes.content:
Take a look at the night sky. You will see billions of stars. Some of them are lone wanderers of the Universe, others unite into constellation.

Even in ancient times stargazers stared at the heavenly dome, explored stars, invented their stories and names.
Today you have an opportunity to walk along the constellation.

Meet our upgraded event - Zodiac!



Взгляните на ночное небо, вы увидите миллиарды звёзд. Некоторые блуждают во Вселенной поодиночке, другие же образовывают созвездия.  

С давних времён звездочёты вглядывались в небесный купол, изучали звёздные плеяды, давали им имена и придумывали легенды. 

Сегодня вы получаете уникальную возможность прогуляться по созвездию. Вы сможете не только прикоснуться к мифическим тайнам древности, но и собрать свои личные звёзды. 

Встречайте акцию "Зодиак"! 


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24294817/9e9bdddccc3efc2215d60f36930795503efd7efc.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Thanksgiving Day continues!
notes.content:
Is there anything better than a magnificent feast shared by the whole family? Join the mansion inhabitants in their merrymaking by completing the new «Family dinner» puzzle. 

The feast will be pleasant and beneficial: put the «Family Dinner» together to receive a «Teddy bear» decoration. This charming toy will brighten your day and increase the amount of freedom points and copper tokens earned by completing rooms by 50%.

Come join us at the Thanksgiving table!


Нет ничего лучше, чем уютным вечером собраться всей семьей за праздничным столом. Присоединяйтесь к торжеству жителей особняка, собрав новый пазл «Семейный ужин»! 

Трапеза окажется не только приятной, но и полезной: тот, кто соберет «Семейный ужин», получит в награду декор «Плюшевый мишка». Эта милая игрушка добавит уюта в вашу комнату, а также на 50% увеличит число очков свободы и медных жетонов, получаемых за прохождение комнат. 

Поспешите сесть за праздничный стол!


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24294817/9ff1422b480509454b6ef62424a9fc2fef896926.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Zodiac event!
notes.content:
Take a look at the night sky. You will see billions of stars. Some of them are lone wanderers of the Universe, others unite into constellation.

Even in ancient times stargazers stared at the heavenly dome, explored stars, invented their stories and names.

Today you have an opportunity to walk along the constellation.

Meet our  event - Zodiac!

Взгляните на ночное небо, вы увидите миллиарды звёзд. Некоторые блуждают во Вселенной поодиночке, другие же образовывают созвездия. 

С давних времён звездочёты вглядывались в небесный купол, изучали звёздные плеяды, давали им имена и придумывали легенды. 

Сегодня вы получаете уникальную возможность прогуляться по созвездию. 

Встречайте акцию "Зодиак"!

notes.title: It's only the begining. The 4th Season is already in the game!
notes.content:
A new threat is knocking at the mansion's door!
And now the life of each person who is locked here is in mortal danger. When it seemed that all the mysteries were unraveled, a mysterious stranger appear in the house.

Who is he? Will he help to destroy the curse, or is he an enemy who wants to see you dead?

At this time, not all the doors will be locked, and your enemies become your allies. Can you stand on the right side and save your friends from the impending threat?

The real truth, which no one knew, is about to open ...

New challenges, new mysteries and new choices are waiting for you!

notes.title: Zodiac.
notes.content:
Take a look at the night sky. You will see billions of stars. Some of them are lone wanderers of the Universe, others unite into constellation.

Even in ancient times stargazers stared at the heavenly dome, explored stars, invented their stories and names.

Today you have an opportunity to walk along the constellation.

Meet our  event - Zodiac!



Взгляните на ночное небо, вы увидите миллиарды звёзд. Некоторые блуждают во Вселенной поодиночке, другие же образовывают созвездия. 

С давних времён звездочёты вглядывались в небесный купол, изучали звёздные плеяды, давали им имена и придумывали легенды. 



Сегодня вы получаете уникальную возможность прогуляться по созвездию. Вы сможете не только прикоснуться к мифическим тайнам древности, но и собрать свои личные звёзды. 

Встречайте  акцию "Зодиак"!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24294817/db9ee211786fab84800bed4826696f5feb96eed9.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Rats and Ravens! Крысы и Вороны!
notes.content:
Can you hear this strange whistling? Do you see silhouettes glimpsing in the rooms? Do you know what is that mean?
That's right! The mechanical toys: rats and crows are coming back!
This means that a new factional fight begins!
But you need to be fast and attentive, or you will not catch them.



Вы уже слышите странный свист? Видите мелькнувшие силуэты в комнатах особняка? 
Это механические игрушки: крысы и вороны! 
А это значит, что начинается новая фракционная борьба. 

Но нужно быть быстрыми и внимательными, а иначе вам не угнаться за этими маленькими символами фракций. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24294817/0725ecff14d2722f1a1eebfa8a4d79364b5c414e.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Rats and Ravens! Крысы и Вороны!
notes.content:
Can you hear this strange whistling? Do you see silhouettes glimpsing in the rooms? Do you know what is that mean?
That's right! The mechanical toys: rats and crows are coming back!
This means that a new factional fight begins!
But you need to be fast and attentive, or you will not catch them.



Вы уже слышите странный свист? Видите мелькнувшие силуэты в комнатах особняка? 
Это механические игрушки: крысы и вороны! 
А это значит, что начинается новая фракционная борьба. 

Но нужно быть быстрыми и внимательными, а иначе вам не угнаться за этими маленькими символами фракций.

notes.title: Harvest Festival! Праздник урожая!
notes.content:
Dear Panic Room players!

Have you ever engaged in wheat and straw breading?
You have a unique chance to try your hand in this unusual 
bussiness. The result will not disappoint you. 
If you are not afraid of fouling hands with hard work - then hurry up to take part 
in the "Harvest Festival" event!


Урожай уже поспел! 

А значит подошло время как следует потрудиться, чтобы собрать его. 
Если поработаете на совесть - то результат превзойдет все ваши ожидания! 

Поспешите принять участие в акции "Праздник урожая" и убедитесь в этом сами!

notes.title: Zodiac
notes.content:
Take a look at the night sky. You will see billions of stars. Some of them are lone wanderers of the Universe, others unite into constellation.

Even in ancient times stargazers stared at the heavenly dome, explored stars, invented their stories and names.

Today you have an opportunity to walk along the constellation.
Meet our event - Zodiac!


Взгляните на ночное небо, вы увидите миллиарды звёзд. Некоторые блуждают во Вселенной по одиночке, другие же образовывают созвездия. 

С давних времён звездочёты вглядывались в небесный купол, изучали звёздные плеяды, давали им имена и придумывали легенды.
Сегодня вы получаете уникальную возможность прогуляться по созвездию. Вы сможете не только прикоснуться к мифическим тайнам древности, но и собрать свои личные звёзды.

Встречайте акцию - "Зодиак"!

notes.content:
Dear  Players!

Wow! Jack is going to give you a gift.

It's a magnetic token which will double the amount of gold and copper tokens for the purchase in the game!

Do not miss this great opportunity!

Each of you who will enter the game till June, 19 can get this present.

Enjoy your game!

Follow the latest news in ‪#‎PanicRoom‬ on ‪#‎Facebook‬


Уважаемые игроки!

Сегодня вас ждёт сюрприз!
Джек дарит вам магнитный жетон, который удвоит количество медных и золотых жетонов при покупке в банке.

Каждый, кто зайдёт в игру с 17 по 19 июня, получит этот полезный подарок!

Вы найдёте его у себя в комнате. Для этого всего лишь стоит взять коробку с надписью "Gift"

Приятной игры!

notes.title: The Panic Room is now in Steam!
notes.content:
Dear Friends!

We are glad to tell you that beloved by many players game "The Panic Room" is available on Steam now!

The mysterious atmosphere of an old mansion and exciting adventures are waiting for you!

It's high time to meet all characters of this enigmatic story and to reveal all the secrets.

Thanks to our players, we are growing and developing!

Enjoy your game!
